Gradio demos in Chinese and English

voice.input_audio: Text, and an instruction as a JSON object with fields for speaker, dialect, style, speaking rate, pitch, volume, emotion, background music and an IP field; optional reference clip with its transcript [ming-test]
voice.output_audio: A wav file written by the cookbook script; the 12.5 Hz continuous tokenizer covers speech, music and sound; the pages read state no sample rate [gh-ming]
voice.voices: 100+ built-in voices and zero-shot voice design from a natural-language description; zero-shot cloning from a clip [gh-ming]
languages: Chinese and English are shown in the maker's examples; Cantonese and other Chinese dialects are named; no full language list was read [gh-ming]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model; the cookbook builds two-speaker podcast dialogue from speaker-labelled lines [ming-test]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights, free under Apache-2.0. The maker tested on NVIDIA H800 80 GB and H20 96 GB GPUs with CUDA 12.4 and gives no minimum [gh-ming]
